# FishHist: Southeast Fisheries Management History Data Package

## Overview

FishHist contains a Management History analysis-ready dataset as well as
functions to help visualize the data available. In their original
format, each record represent Federal Register (FR) changes in
management actions affecting federally managed species throughout the
Gulf of America, South Atlantic, and U.S. Caribbean regions. The example
dataset links and reconciles overlapping actions that modify or replace
prior rules over time.

# Package index

## Functions

The functions built within this package to visualize and format
fisheries management data

- [`expand_status()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/expand_status.md)
  : Expand management status
- [`gantt_FMP()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/gantt_FMP.md)
  : Gantt chart of FMPs
- [`plot_mcats_sector()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/plot_mcats_sector.md)
  : FMP plot by sector
- [`plot_mcats_spp()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/plot_mcats_spp.md)
  : FMP plot for managed species
- [`plot_species_timeline()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/plot_species_timeline.md)
  : Timeline visual
- [`process_closures()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/process_closures.md)
  : Process Closure-related management types
- [`tab_definitions()`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/tab_definitions.md)
  : Definitions Table

## Datasets

Example processed analysis-ready Southeast Fisheries Management Dataset
that can be used for practicing use of the package’s functions

- [`fishhist`](https://supreme-broccoli-2mkenmw.pages.github.io/reference/fishhist.md)
  : Management History data through 2025
